# Transfer Market and quick sell reference

The Transfer Market is simulated locally: about 120 computer listings at a time, most listed for one hour. Your listings sell to simulated buyers; a 5% fee is taken from each sale.

| Rule | Value |
|---|---|
| Price range | 150 – 15,000,000 coins |
| Non-special bronze/silver cap | 10,000 coins |
| Sale chance at ≤90% of fair price | 95% |
| Instant sale | Priced ≤70% of fair: sells in 2–20 s |

## Quick sell (players)

Quick sell pays rating × factor, rounded half up. Earned (untradeable) items quick sell for 0.

| Quality | Common | Rare | Special |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bronze | 3/10 | 3/4 | 20/1 |
| Silver | 3/2 | 7/2 | 70/1 |
| Gold | 4/1 | 8/1 | 122/1 |
